decisions.reason: As a formulation close to the firm’s established portfolio and shown on its own product page, this vertigo combination tablet fits existing knowledge and gives the firm a strong basis to learn, improve, and commercialize it further.

This generic antidepressant hard capsule is relatively distant from the firm’s established offer, so despite the firm’s solid manufacturing capabilities it likely yields weaker absorptive spillovers and less scope for differentiated improvement than nearer products.

The combination antihypertensive film tablet is close to the firm’s existing competencies in pharmaceutical formulations and was actively presented, making it a good candidate for continued refinement through the firm’s in-house R&D and transfer know-how.

The bone and joint dietary supplement builds directly on the firm’s self-care and pharmacy-oriented offer and supports its strategy of differentiated non-reimbursement products, so the firm can exploit existing market and formulation knowledge effectively.
